SIT313 Secure Frontend Applications

Task P3: DEV@Deakin Home Page

Student: Aakash

Implementation

The website uses React and Vite to display the existing portfolio and the DEV@Deakin home page sections. App renders Home and Footer. Home combines the banner, profile, projects, gallery, featured articles, featured tutorials and newsletter components. This parent-child structure keeps each section separate and easier to maintain.

Article and tutorial content is stored in arrays in src/data/data.js. Each section uses map() to create its cards, passes an item through props and uses its id as the React key. Cards display an image, title, description, rating and author.

Response to feedback

A reusable Icon component now provides inline SVG graphics. Both card sections use a gold star icon beside each rating. The footer uses Facebook, Twitter and Instagram SVG icons instead of mixing text symbols with an SVG. Accessible labels identify the social icons and describe each rating. A code-symbol favicon was also added to public/favicon.svg, matching the existing reference in index.html. The original page layout and teal colour scheme are retained.

The newsletter is a frontend form with email validation and a status message; it does not send emails. The social icons are visual elements and do not link to personal accounts.

Verification

The production build and ESLint check passed. Browser checks found six rating SVGs, three social SVGs and no broken page images. At a 390px viewport the page content width was also 390px, with no horizontal overflow. The screenshots below show the updated local website.
